## Summary
Senior Software Engineer specializing in production Python and polyglot microservices (FastAPI, Node.js/NestJS) on AWS serverless and cloud architectures. Expert in event-driven systems, API security (Auth0, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, RBAC), and high-throughput data layers (MongoDB/MongoEngine, PostgreSQL, MySQL). AI-native engineering background: LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), GitHub Copilot Agent Mode, Claude Code.
